expected_rate: one row for every Slack message the bot sends through alerts.py (fill cards, stop pages, reports routed through send_slack); dozens per trading day
window_reason: Fill cards go out every trading session, so the first full session after deploy writes rows.
reversal: no rows after a full session with fills, a row whose first_line still shows broker JSON / an order id / an ALL_CAPS_STATE name, or a scrub warning on a message that lost a needed fact
